info.prompt: A high-tech cathedral interior fused with cyberpunk neon, where the team-shared charge meter arcs across the top like a glowing ribcage of skeletal gold filigree, pulsing with neon cyan and electric magenta energy—each Farkle causes the meter to violently recoil, sending jagged amber sparks across the void-black background, while the ultimate VFX wrapper manifests as a cascading neural lattice of synaptic geometry, crystalline dice suspended in mid-air like bio-mechanical relics, the whole scene bathed in oscilloscope waveforms and hacker-terminal overlays that scroll commit logs in jagged, glitching text.
